claim_summary: STReasoner adds a temporal encoder and spatial-aware reinforcement learning to train LLMs for spatio-temporal reasoning over graph-structured time series.

claim_evidence.quote: STReasoner, which integrates a dedicated time series encoder with LLM to process numerical time series and textual inputs.
spatial-aware group relative policy optimization (S-GRPO), which assigns additional reward only when spatial information improves performance.

modules.name: Temporal series encoder
modules.scope_reason: R2 places the patch encoder on the LLM side because it changes how temporal inputs are represented for the model; R3 Harness layer tests do not apply.

evidence.quote: we patchify the input time series (Nie, 2022) and encode each patch using a lightweight five-layer MLP (Time Series Encoder).

modules.name: Spatio-temporal alignment and reasoning training
modules.scope_reason: R2 places alignment pretraining and reasoning SFT on the LLM side because they train the model to align text with series embeddings and inject spatio-temporal reasoning priors; R3 Harness layer tests do not apply.

evidence.quote: In the first stage, we perform large-scale alignment pretraining using ST-Align.
The selected reasoning trajectories are aggregated to form the ST-CoT dataset, which is then used to perform SFT.

modules.name: Spatial-aware GRPO
modules.scope_reason: R2 places the learned reasoning objective on the LLM side because it updates the model policy; it does not train selection of workflow tools/actions, so workflow_learning is not applicable. R3 Harness layer tests do not apply.

evidence.quote: we propose Spatial-Aware GRPO (S-GRPO), which introduces a contrastive reward mechanism that explicitly encourages spatial reasoning

modules.name: Scenario-constrained network-SDE synthesis
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK applies because the synthesis procedure is designed to produce task-specific spatio-temporal QA data; changing from this task family requires changing scenario specifications and QA generation. R3_2 GTS is not chosen because the core is bound to this synthesis objective, while R3_3 GH is less specific. The network SDE explicitly models temporal dynamics, so processing applies.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - task-specific spatio-temporal data and QA synthesis
R3_2_GTS:no - bound to a synthesis task

evidence.quote: we propose a network SDEs-based multi-agent data synthesis pipeline
we generate two spatio-temporal QA datasets: ST-Bench and ST-Align.

task_performance.quote: STReasoner achieves the best overall performance among open-source and time series models across all four tasks.

notes: The synthesis pipeline is classified as TSK because its core output is task-specific synthetic QA data; its training-data role overlaps with dataset construction. ST-Bench is an evaluation dataset of a method paper and is excluded under R1. The experiments report task accuracy/forecasting error but no explicit temporal leakage or information-availability validation.
